g.text: Groups: hotkey audio [asr] refine feedback analytics delivery
Changes apply to new sessions and jobs; running work keeps its current settings.
Cached speech-recognition model. Downloads require a separate command.
Numeric format used by the speech-recognition model.
Search width. On one 6.49 s public CPU clip (int8, hotwords and context off), large-v3-turbo beam 1 scored
10.12% WER at 1.664 s median; beam 5 scored 9.31% at 1.683 s median.
Comma-separated names and terms to guide recognition; blank disables them.
Optional style or domain context for recognition.
Skip audio that the model classifies as non-speech.
Reject recognition results below the speech confidence threshold.
Unload the idle recognition worker after this many seconds; zero disables it.
Recognition worker CPU threads; zero selects automatically.
